payload.name: Task-related behavioral history in sensory thalamus
payload.fact: Decision and reward history (trial history) are reflected in the spike responses of the ventro-posterior medial thalamus (VPm) in rats.

provenance.title: Birthweight between 14 and 42 weeks' gestation.
provenance.quote_or_locus: This study provides evidence that decision and reward history can already be reflected in the ascending sensory pathway, on the level of first order sensory thalamus
